title.zh: MCP 新增：撤销、和声、旋律与声调检查
title.en: MCP gains undo, harmony, melody and a prosody check

highlights.zh: undo_song：每次改动都有 opId，get_song 列出可回退的历史。
highlights.en: undo_song: every change carries an opId, and get_song lists what is undoable.

highlights.zh: set_chord_progression / suggest_progression：按情绪挑选进行并渲染到指定调。
highlights.en: set_chord_progression and suggest_progression: choose a progression by emotion and render it in a key.

highlights.zh: generate_melody（轮廓优先、AABA、音域受限）与 validate_prosody（倒字只警告）。
highlights.en: generate_melody (contour-first, AABA, range-bounded) and validate_prosody (倒字, advisory).
